explanation: An intercept is where a graph crosses an axis. To find the y-intercept set x = 0 -- on a line that gives y = b (the green point). To find the x-intercept set y = 0 and solve -- that gives x = -b/m (the pink point). Slide m and b and watch both crossings move; when the line is horizontal (m = 0) it never crosses the x-axis, so that intercept disappears.
bullets: y-intercept: plug in x = 0; for y = mx + b that is (0, b).
x-intercept: plug in y = 0 and solve, giving x = -b/m.
A horizontal line (m = 0) has no x-intercept unless it IS the x-axis.
